author: BackStreet_Punk
quote:
Didn't have an idea about the game. Bought it after i saw a video and read an article about this new game.

This was like an apocalypse to me! A complete new gameplay universe unfolded as i played this in Early Access! I've clocked 45 hours for the last 2 months when i bought Carmageddon : Reincarnation!
Magnificent physics, awesome stunts, good mindless humor, and PHENOMENAL crushes and damage physics!

On my PC (Overclocked at 4.7Ghz), GTX 760Ti it always runs above 45FPS, and that's smooth. Not great but good performance!
If you like wrecking and causing mayhem with crazy vehicles i highly recommend this.
